result.stdout:
Usage: credfeto-git-mcp [--self-test | --help]

With no option, serves MCP over stdio for the repository in GIT_MCP_REPO_ROOT (when unset, /workspace/repo if it exists, else the git root of the current directory; a value that is not an absolute path is an
error). The chosen repository root and where it came from are written to stderr at startup.

Options:
  --self-test  Builds the server's tools and finds git on PATH, then exits: 0 when that works, 1 with a
               one-line reason on stderr when it does not. Starts no MCP transport, reads no input and runs
               no git command except, when GIT_MCP_REPO_ROOT is unset and the default folder is missing,
               the one that finds the repository root.
  -h, --help   Shows this help and exits.
